title: Just using for 10 minutes
text: Just using for 10 minutes. Product looks great in a photo. I took off the little plastic baby’s breath sprig that is plastic. I also glued on the back better so it wouldn’t come off. For pictures it is fine. For a formal wedding, eh, don’t think I’d use it. Then again, for 5 bucks, I didn’t expect more. Have to say it was super quick shipping! 2 days,thanks!
